Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quotation for the stainless pump shaft SH-220.

We have reviewed your terms and would like to propose two packages for your consideration:

- Option A: EUR 15.39 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 21 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 15.23 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 21 days, DAP Hollerau

Both packages have the same lead time and delivery terms. Option B has a slightly lower unit price in exchange for earlier payment. Please let us know which package suits you better.

Could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

Thank you, and we look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
Your requested terms change our costs; our Angebot for them follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you.
The requested Lieferzeit is not feasible; we quote our earliest.
Faster payment helps our cash flow; that is reflected in the price.
A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in.
A different delivery term moves the freight between us; that is priced in.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your reply and for answering our payment days option. We have reviewed your offer of EUR 17.20 per unit and your notes on lead time, freight and cost structure.

Another bidder quotes EUR 16.50 per unit for this part (offer:DEMO-J1-1).

On that basis, our price position stays as it is. We have changed the package and offer two options:

- Option A: EUR 14.40 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 21 days, DAP Hollerau.
- Option B: EUR 13.97 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 21 days, EXW, so the freight is on our side.

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to your answer.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery EXW.
Please let me explain.
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We acknowledge the alternative offer you mentioned; however, our proposal ensures the high quality and reliability required for this component.
We manufacture strictly according to your drawings; any cost-saving modifications to the part or process would require prior review and approval by your engineering department.
We can offer a revised price of €17.10 per unit for DAP delivery, with the lead time remaining at our fastest feasible 28 days.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your reply and for the cost breakdown. We appreciate that you moved on the price and that you confirmed the 14-day payment term.

We have reviewed your offer and moved a step towards you as well. Both of our packages keep the 14 days net payment you asked for:

- Option A: EUR 15.78 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 21 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 15.19 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 21 days, EXW

The difference between the two is the delivery term: in Option A you deliver to our site, and in Option B we collect from yours.

We would also like to ask: is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to your view on both packages.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 21 days, delivery EXW.

Hallo, EXW is good, saves me calling the truck guys.
